docs.summary:
Generates a second UV set (UV2) suitable for lightmapping by running Prowl.Unwrapper over a mesh and baking the resulting atlas UVs into [`UV2`](#api~Prowl.Runtime.Resources.Mesh~UV2).

The unwrapper produces **per-corner** UVs (one per triangle corner) with seams between charts, whereas a Mesh stores **per-vertex** attributes. So we split vertices wherever corners that share an original vertex disagree on their lightmap UV, duplicating every other attribute (position, normal, uv, tangent, color, bone data) onto the new vertices. The index buffer keeps the same length and triangle order, so existing submesh ranges stay valid.
Unwrap `mesh` and write the result into its UV2 channel. Best-effort: on failure (degenerate geometry, etc.) it logs a warning and leaves the mesh unchanged.
